posts.title: A Log Line Cannot Prove a Message Was Processed
posts.summary: Define processing by its durable effect and acknowledgement boundary, not by an optimistic log line emitted at the start of a handler.

posts.title: Agent Tool Calls Need Traces, Not Just Logs
posts.summary: Tool logs answer what ran. A trace answers which agent decision caused it, what it waited on, and whether the failure belongs to the model, orchestration, or downstream service.

posts.title: An Incident Timeline Needs Two Clocks
posts.summary: Record when an event occurred and when your system learned about it. Delayed delivery, clock skew, and retries make the distinction operationally necessary.
